aaron.title: Aaron
aaron.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
aaron.note: Moses's older brother, and the one God sent to do the talking when Moses said he could not. He became Israel's first high priest, and the priesthood ran through his sons after him. Most of the time he is standing next to Moses.

abijah.title: Abijah
abijah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
abijah.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

adaiah-7.title: Adaiah
adaiah-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adaiah-7.note: Nehemiah's list carries him, and nothing else does.

adaiah.title: Adaiah
adaiah.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
adaiah.note: He is a priest in the returning community. The Levite lists name him and nothing else does.

adna-2.title: Adna
adna-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adna-2.note: One of the priests in Nehemiah's register of the house of Harim.

adullam.title: Adullam
adullam.note: A Canaanite royal city in the Shephelah, near the valley of Elah. David killed Goliath in that valley. Later, running from Saul, he hid in a cave near Adullam, and his family joined him there, and so did everyone in distress.

ahasai.title: Ahasai
ahasai.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
ahasai.note: One of the priests in the list of those who resettled Jerusalem after the exile, named as an ancestor of Maasiai. 1 Chronicles 9:12 gives the same man as Jahzerah.

ahitub.title: Ahitub
ahitub.about: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
ahitub.note: Ahimelech's father, in Israel's high priestly line.

ai.title: Ai
ai.note: A fortified Canaanite city near Bethel. Israel's first attack was thrown back because of Achan's hidden sin, and once that was dealt with Joshua took the city by ambush. The site is usually identified with et-Tell, though digging there has turned up little from the right period.

akkub.title: Akkub
akkub.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
akkub.note: The name keeps turning up among the Levites, gatekeepers and temple servants who came back from exile, in Ezra and Nehemiah alike.

amariah.title: Amariah
amariah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
amariah.note: One of several priests called Amariah, this one in Nehemiah's lists at 10:3 and 12:2.

amariah-8.title: Amariah
amariah-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
amariah-8.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

amashai.title: Amashai
amashai.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
amashai.note: A priest, Azareel's son, appointed to live in Jerusalem after the exile and help with the temple work.

amok.title: Amok
amok.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
amok.note: A priest who came back from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel and headed a priestly family. In the days of the high priest Joiakim, his descendant Eber held that place.

amzi-2.title: Amzi
amzi-2.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
amzi-2.note: A priest in the Jerusalem settlement lists after the exile.

ananiah.title: Ananiah
ananiah.note: Named once, in Nehemiah, and nowhere else.

anathoth.title: Anathoth
anathoth.note: A priestly town in Benjamin, about three miles north of Jerusalem, and Jeremiah's home. He bought a field there as a sign of hope while announcing Jerusalem's fall. The site is identified with the village of Anata.

artaxerxes.title: Artaxerxes
artaxerxes.note: He funded Ezra's return to Jerusalem with the temple articles and orders to teach the law, and later sent Nehemiah to rebuild the city's walls. A Persian king backing Judah's restoration.

asaph-3.title: Asaph
asaph-3.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
asaph-3.note: One of 4 men called Asaph. This one is a Levite from the exile and the return, named twice in 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah.

asaph.title: Asaph
asaph.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asaph.note: A Levite David put in charge of one of the temple choirs. Twelve psalms carry his name, Psalm 50 and Psalms 73 to 83, which means either he wrote them or a guild of musicians kept his name for generations.

athaiah.title: Athaiah
athaiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
athaiah.note: A descendant of Pharez, of Judah, who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile. 1 Chronicles 9:4 calls the same man, or his line, Uthai.

azarael-5.title: Azarael
azarael-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azarael-5.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

azarael.title: Azarael
azarael.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
azarael.note: A priest from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

azariah-4.title: Azariah
azariah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azariah-4.note: An Azariah in Nehemiah's lists, at 7:7, 10:2 and 12:33. The name was common and nothing more is known of him.

azekah.title: Azekah
azekah.note: A fortified town in Judah's Shephelah. Joshua routed five Amorite kings near it in a hailstorm. A Lachish ostracon written during Nebuchadnezzar's last campaign says the writer is watching for Lachish's signal fires but cannot see Azekah, which some read as Azekah already fallen and others as a line of sight he never had.

azmaveth.title: Azmaveth
azmaveth.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
azmaveth.note: He fought for David and made the list of David's thirty. The same name belonged to a town near Jerusalem and to several other men. His own record is a line in each of the two lists of the thirty.

azrikam-2.title: Azrikam
azrikam-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
azrikam-2.note: He was a palace official, killed alongside King Ahaz's son when the invasion came.

babel.title: Babel
babel.note: The plain in Shinar where people, still speaking one language after the flood, set out to build a city and a tower reaching to the heavens and make a name for themselves. God answered by confusing their language.

bakbukiah.title: Bakbukiah
bakbukiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bakbukiah.note: A Levite in Jerusalem after the exile, serving among the temple musicians and gatekeepers.

balaam.title: Balaam
balaam.about: Prophet living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
balaam.note: A prophet, but not an Israelite. Balak of Moab hired him to curse the Israelites. On the way his donkey saw an angel blocking the road that Balaam himself missed, and God made the animal speak to rebuke him.

bani-8.title: Bani
bani-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bani-8.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

baruch-3.title: Baruch
baruch-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
baruch-3.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

beer-shebah.title: Beer-shebah
beer-shebah.note: From Dan to Beersheba meant all of Israel, top to bottom, and this was the bottom. It marked the southern edge of Judah's land and went first to Simeon. Genesis gives two separate stories for how it got its name.

benjamin.title: Benjamin
benjamin.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
benjamin.note: Jacob's twelfth son and the youngest, born to Rachel on the road near Bethlehem as she died giving birth to him. Jacob guarded him fiercely after losing Joseph. That fear drives much of the tension in Joseph's story.

benjamin-4.title: Benjamin
benjamin-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
benjamin-4.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

beth-el.title: Beth-el
beth-el.note: About ten miles north of Jerusalem, and once the Canaanite city of Luz. Abram built an altar there. Jacob dreamed of a ladder reaching to heaven there and called the place house of God.

beth-gilgal.title: Beth-gilgal
beth-gilgal.note: It is probably the Gilgal near Jericho where Israel first camped, and it sent singers to the dedication of Jerusalem's rebuilt walls under Nehemiah.

beth-palet.title: Beth-palet
beth-palet.note: House of flight, a town in the far south of Judah, in the district bordering Edom. It turns up again after the exile, spelled Beth-phelet.

bilgah.title: Bilgah
bilgah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bilgah.note: Head of one of the twenty-four priestly divisions that took turns serving in the temple. His family name turns up again among the priests who came back from exile.

binnui.title: Binnui
binnui.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
binnui.note: A common Levitical name. Men called Binnui turn up among the wall builders under Nehemiah and among the men confronted over foreign marriages under Ezra.

bunni-2.title: Bunni
bunni-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bunni-2.note: One of 3 men called Bunni. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

canan-9.title: Canan
canan-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
canan-9.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

col-hozeh.title: Col-hozeh
col-hozeh.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
col-hozeh.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

darius-3.title: Darius
darius-3.about: Emperor living at the time of Exile and Return
darius-3.note: A Persian king named once, in Nehemiah. Darius was a title several kings carried, and the verse leaves it there.

david.title: David
david.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
david.note: The shepherd from Bethlehem who killed Goliath and became Israel's second king, ruling a kingdom bigger than any native king held before or after. Solomon was one of his sons. Nearly half the psalms carry his name, and the Tel Dan inscription, where an enemy king boasts over the house of David, put his dynasty outside the Bible as well.

dibon-2.title: Dibon
dibon-2.note: Named once, in Nehemiah, and nowhere else.

eber-5.title: Eber
eber-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eber-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

elam-7.title: Elam
elam-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elam-7.note: One of 7 men called Elam. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

eleazar-8.title: Eleazar
eleazar-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eleazar-8.note: One of 8 men called Eleazar. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

eliakim-4.title: Eliakim
eliakim-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliakim-4.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

eliashib-3.title: Eliashib
eliashib-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliashib-3.note: One of 9 men called Eliashib. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Nehemiah.

eliashib.title: Eliashib
eliashib.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
eliashib.note: High priest while Nehemiah was governor. He gave Tobiah, Nehemiah's opponent, a room inside the temple, and Nehemiah threw Tobiah out the moment he found out.

elihoenai-8.title: Elihoenai
elihoenai-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elihoenai-8.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

en-rimmon.title: En-rimmon
en-rimmon.note: Spring of the pomegranate, a Negev town resettled after the exile. It likely joins Ain and Rimmon, which the older tribal lists name separately.

ephraim.title: Ephraim
ephraim.about: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ephraim.note: Joseph's younger son. When Jacob blessed the two boys he crossed his hands on purpose and gave Ephraim the bigger blessing over Manasseh. The tribe came to dominate the north so much that the prophets use Ephraim for the whole northern kingdom.

ezer-5.title: Ezer
ezer-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ezer-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

ezra-2.title: Ezra
ezra-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ezra-2.note: He is not the famous scribe but a priest in Nehemiah's list of those who came back earlier under Zerubbabel, and he is named only there.

ezra.title: Ezra
ezra.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
ezra.note: The priest and scribe who led a second return from exile, from Babylon to Jerusalem. In Nehemiah 8 he reads the law aloud to the whole assembled people, and they weep.

gaba.title: Gaba
gaba.note: Another English spelling of Geba, a Levitical city in Benjamin by the pass of Michmash. Jonathan raided a Philistine garrison there, and later it marked the line between the northern and southern kingdoms.

gabbai.title: Gabbai
gabbai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
gabbai.note: Nehemiah's census of Jerusalem after the exile lists him as head of a family of Benjamin, and nothing else is recorded about him.

galal.title: Galal
galal.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
galal.note: A Levite among those who settled back in Jerusalem after the exile, listed in Chronicles and Nehemiah.

gilalai.title: Gilalai
gilalai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
gilalai.note: In the procession at the dedication of Nehemiah's walls he was one of the priests' sons playing instruments. Nothing further is recorded about him.

ginnetho.title: Ginnetho
ginnetho.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ginnetho.note: A priest who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, and his family is one of the priestly houses Nehemiah lists.

gispa.title: Gispa
gispa.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
gispa.note: With Ziha he was over the Nethinim, the temple servants living on the hill of Ophel after the return. Nothing more is known of him.

gittaim.title: Gittaim
gittaim.note: The people of Beeroth fled to Gittaim, probably a Benjamin town, and after the exile Benjaminite families settled it again.

hadid.title: Hadid
hadid.note: Exiles back from Babylon resettled it, a Benjamin town grouped with Lod and Ono in the lists. It is el-Haditheh, a few miles east of Lydda.

hananeel.title: Hananeel
hananeel.note: A tower on Jerusalem's north wall. Nehemiah lists it among the stretches rebuilt, and Jeremiah and Zechariah use it as a landmark when they describe the city to come.

hanani-5.title: Hanani
hanani-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hanani-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

hananiah-11.title: Hananiah
hananiah-11.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hananiah-11.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him. The verse is Nehemiah 12:12.

hananiah-12.title: Hananiah
hananiah-12.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hananiah-12.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once. The verse is Nehemiah 12:41.

harim.title: Harim
harim.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
harim.note: The third priestly course in 1 Chronicles 24:8 went by this name, and the family came back from exile. Some of them were among the men Ezra confronted for marrying foreign wives.

hasenuah-including-the-art.title: Hasenuah
hasenuah-including-the-art.note: The Hebrew name carries the article, the Senuah. A Benjamite family that settled in Jerusalem after the exile traced itself back to him.

hashabiah-3.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabiah-3.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

hashabiah.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabiah.note: He served in Ezra's day; the name was a common Levitical one, carried by musicians, officials and administrators over several generations.

hashabiah-8.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabiah-8.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

hashabiah-9.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabiah-9.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hashub.title: Hashub
hashub.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
hashub.note: The Levite of this name in the lists of those living in Jerusalem after the return.

hattush.title: Hattush
hattush.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hattush.note: The Hattush in these verses is a priest, listed once among the men who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and once among the priests who came back. The note about David's descendant who came with Ezra fits a different man.

hazaiah.title: Hazaiah
hazaiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hazaiah.note: A man of Judah from the Shilonite clan, Shelah's line, who settled in Jerusalem after the exile. Nothing else is recorded about him.

hazar-shual.title: Hazar-shual
hazar-shual.note: Village of the jackal. It sat on Judah's southern border and later fell inside Simeon's share, and people came back to live there after the exile. It is commonly placed near Tell es-Sa'weh, between Beersheba and Moladah.

hazor-6.title: Hazor
hazor-6.note: Nehemiah names him once, and nothing else is recorded.

helkai.title: Helkai
helkai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
helkai.note: He headed a priestly family in the days of Joiakim the high priest. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hillkiah.title: Hillkiah
hillkiah.about: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hillkiah.note: The high priest under Josiah who found a forgotten scroll of the law while the temple was being repaired. What he found set off Judah's last great reform.

hillkiah-3.title: Hillkiah
hillkiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hillkiah-3.note: One of 7 men called Hillkiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Nehemiah.

horonite.title: Horonite
horonite.note: Sanballat's label, and the man was one of Nehemiah's chief opponents over the wall. It probably means he came from Horonaim in Moab or from one of the Beth-horons. The Elephantine papyri name him as governor of Samaria.

hoshaiah-2.title: Hoshaiah
hoshaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hoshaiah-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

iddo-3.title: Iddo
iddo-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
iddo-3.note: One of 5 men called Iddo. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Nehemiah.

immer-2.title: Immer
immer-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
immer-2.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

isaiah.title: Isaiah
isaiah.about: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
isaiah.note: Amoz's son, a prophet in Jerusalem in the eighth century, who counselled four kings of Judah and is quoted in the New Testament more than any other prophet. He gave his two sons names that were sermons, Shear-jashub and Maher-shalal-hash-baz. When Sennacherib besieged Jerusalem he told Hezekiah the city would stand, and the Taylor Prism brags of the siege without ever claiming the city fell.

israel.title: Israel
israel.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
israel.note: God gave Jacob this name after he wrestled through the night at Peniel. It became the name of the nation that came from his twelve sons, and later of the northern kingdom and of the land. For the man himself, see Jacob.

ithiel.title: Ithiel
ithiel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ithiel.note: One of the Benjamite ancestors of the families who settled Jerusalem after the exile.

izrahiah.title: Izrahiah
izrahiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
izrahiah.note: Two men. One is a chief of Issachar in the genealogies; the other, generations later, is at the dedication of Jerusalem's rebuilt walls under Nehemiah.

jachin-2.title: Jachin
jachin-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jachin-2.note: One of 4 men called Jachin. This one is a Levite from the exile and the return, named twice in 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah.

jaddua.title: Jaddua
jaddua.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
jaddua.note: Nehemiah's list of high priests ends with him, among the last priests the Old Testament names.

jarmuth.title: Jarmuth
jarmuth.note: Its king joined the march on Gibeon after Gibeon made peace with Israel, and Joshua beat them in the battle where the sun stood still.

jedaiah.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jedaiah.note: The name was common among priests after the exile. Several who came back from Babylon and served in the rebuilt temple carried it.

jedaiah-3.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jedaiah-3.note: One of 4 men called Jedaiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Nehemiah.

jeduthun-2.title: Jeduthun
jeduthun-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jeduthun-2.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

jehohanan-6.title: Jehohanan
jehohanan-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jehohanan-6.note: One of 8 men called Jehohanan. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

jehohanan-7.title: Jehohanan
jehohanan-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jehohanan-7.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

jehoiada-3.title: Jehoiada
jehoiada-3.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
jehoiada-3.note: A high priest after the exile, in Nehemiah's list between his father and his son. One of his sons married into the family of Nehemiah's enemy, and Nehemiah drove him out.

jekabzeel.title: Jekabzeel
jekabzeel.note: The longer spelling of Kabzeel, the southernmost town of Judah, out on the border with Edom. Nehemiah lists it among the towns people of Judah lived in again after the exile. Benaiah, one of David's warriors and later the head of his bodyguard, came from there.

jeremiah-2.title: Jeremiah
jeremiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeremiah-2.note: Not the prophet. This Jeremiah is a priest in Nehemiah: he came back from Babylon with the first returns, his name stands on the covenant in Nehemiah 10, and his family is still counted among the priestly houses a generation on.

jeroham-2.title: Jeroham
jeroham-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jeroham-2.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

jerusalem.title: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: David took it from the Jebusites and made it his capital, and once Solomon's temple stood there it was the centre of Israel's worship for a thousand years. Babylon destroyed it, the exiles rebuilt it, Rome destroyed it again in AD 70. Jesus died and rose just outside its walls, and Revelation ends with a new Jerusalem coming down from heaven.

jeshanah.title: Jeshanah
jeshanah.note: Abijah of Judah captured this northern town from Jeroboam, with Bethel and Ephron, in a battle Judah won though badly outnumbered. It is generally identified with Burj el-Isaneh, north of Bethel. Nehemiah's Jeshanah gate in Jerusalem is a different thing.

jeshua-6.title: Jeshua
jeshua-6.note: Nehemiah names him once, and nothing else is recorded.

jeshua.title: Jeshua
jeshua.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeshua.note: Joshua, shortened the way people said it after the exile. The man who carries it furthest is Jeshua son of Jozadak, the high priest who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel and rebuilt the altar and then the temple. Haggai and Zechariah call him Joshua and set him beside Zerubbabel as a picture of the coming priest-king.

jeshua-7.title: Jeshua
jeshua-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeshua-7.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

jew.title: Jew
jew.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
jew.note: The word comes from Judah. At first it meant someone from the kingdom of Judah, and after the exile it came to cover the whole covenant people descended from Abraham, whatever tribe they came from.

joed.title: Joed
joed.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
joed.note: A Benjamite in the line of Sallu, among those who went back to live in Jerusalem after the exile. Nothing else is recorded of him.

joel-14.title: Joel
joel-14.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
joel-14.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

johanan-3.title: Johanan
johanan-3.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
johanan-3.note: One of 5 men called Johanan. This one is a priest from the exile and the return, named twice in Nehemiah.

joiakim.title: Joiakim
joiakim.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
joiakim.note: Joshua's son and Eliashib's father, high priest in the years between the temple's completion and Nehemiah's reforms.

joiarib.title: Joiarib
joiarib.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
joiarib.note: One of David's twenty-four priestly divisions was headed by Joiarib, and his descendants show up again among the priestly families after the exile.

joiarib-3.title: Joiarib
joiarib-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
joiarib-3.note: One of 3 men called Joiarib. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

jonathan.title: Jonathan
jonathan.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
jonathan.note: Saul's eldest son, heir to the throne, and David's friend. He made a covenant with David knowing it cost him the crown. Once, with only his armour-bearer, he climbed a cliff and started a rout of the Philistine army. He died with Saul and two brothers on Mount Gilboa, and David's lament for him says his love was "surpassing the love of women."

jonathan-11.title: Jonathan
jonathan-11.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jonathan-11.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

jonathan-12.title: Jonathan
jonathan-12.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jonathan-12.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

josabad-8.title: Josabad
josabad-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
josabad-8.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

joseph-9.title: Joseph
joseph-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
joseph-9.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

jozadak.title: Jozadak
jozadak.about: High Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
jozadak.note: A high priest taken into exile in Babylon. His son Joshua led the priesthood when the exiles came back and rebuilt the temple. Most of his story sits under Jehozadak.

judah.title: Judah
judah.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
judah.note: Leah's fourth son, and the brother who ends up leading. He talked the others into selling Joseph rather than killing him, and later offered himself as a hostage in Benjamin's place. His tribe produced David's royal line and gave its name to the southern kingdom, and Jacob's dying blessing promised the sceptre would not leave him.

judah-3.title: Judah
judah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
judah-3.note: One of 5 men called Judah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

judah-4.title: Judah
judah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
judah-4.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

judah-5.title: Judah
judah-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
judah-5.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

kadmiel.title: Kadmiel
kadmiel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
kadmiel.note: A Levite who led worship and helped oversee the rebuilding when the exiles came back, under Zerubbabel and later under Nehemiah.

kallai.title: Kallai
kallai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
kallai.note: He was a priest in Joiakim's time, head of the family of Sallai, in a list of priestly family heads.

kirjath-arba.title: Kirjath-arba
kirjath-arba.note: "Arba's city," Hebron's older name, after a great man among the Anakim. Sarah died there and Abraham bought the cave of Machpelah close by to bury her. Joshua gave it to Caleb for the faithful report he brought back as a spy.

kolaiah-2.title: Kolaiah
kolaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
kolaiah-2.note: Benjamite ancestor of one of the exiles who came back and settled in Jerusalem. He is a different man from the Kolaiah whose son Ahab was a false prophet in Babylon.

lachish.title: Lachish
lachish.note: A heavily fortified Canaanite royal city in Judah's lowlands. Joshua took it, Rehoboam rebuilt it into one of Judah's strongest fortresses, and in 701 BC Sennacherib's Assyrians took it again. Assyria carved the siege on wall reliefs now in the British Museum. The ruins at Tell ed-Duweir also gave up the Lachish Letters, written during Babylon's last siege, just before Jerusalem fell.

lod.title: Lod
lod.note: They called it Lydda in New Testament Greek. Over seven hundred people came back from exile to this town of Benjamin, on the plain along the road from Jerusalem to Joppa. Modern Lod, by Tel Aviv's airport, keeps the name.

maadiah.title: Maadiah
maadiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maadiah.note: A priest who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel. His family was one of the priestly houses under Joiakim, called Moadiah a few verses on.

maai.title: Maai
maai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maai.note: He played the instruments of David in the procession with Ezra when Jerusalem's rebuilt wall was dedicated, and appears nowhere else.

maaseiah-15.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-15.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-15.note: One of 20 men called Maaseiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah. The verse is Nehemiah 11:5.

maaseiah-16.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-16.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-16.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him. The verse is Nehemiah 11:7.

maaseiah-17.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-17.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-17.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once. The verse is Nehemiah 12:41.

maaseiah-18.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-18.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-18.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return. The verse is Nehemiah 12:42.

mahalaleel-2.title: Mahalaleel
mahalaleel-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mahalaleel-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

malchijah.title: Malchijah
malchijah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
malchijah.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

malchijah-7.title: Malchijah
malchijah-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malchijah-7.note: One of 12 men called Malchijah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah. The verse is Nehemiah 12:42.

malluch.title: Malluch
malluch.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malluch.note: One of those who signed the covenant renewal under Nehemiah, carrying a name common among the priests after the exile.

mattaniah.title: Mattaniah
mattaniah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
mattaniah.note: Zedekiah's name before Nebuchadnezzar made him king and changed it.

mattaniah-10.title: Mattaniah
mattaniah-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattaniah-10.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

mattaniah-3.title: Mattaniah
mattaniah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattaniah-3.note: One of 10 men called Mattaniah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Nehemiah.

mattenai-3.title: Mattenai
mattenai-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattenai-3.note: A priest in Nehemiah's lists, and the name was common after the exile.

meah.title: Meah
meah.note: The Tower of the Hundred, on Jerusalem's north wall. The priests rebuilt it when Nehemiah restored the city's defences after the exile, and the name probably came from its height in cubits or a measure of the wall beside it.

mekonah.title: Mekonah
mekonah.note: Jewish families back from Babylon resettled this town in the Negev of Judah. Nehemiah lists it next to Ziklag, and nobody has found where it stood.

meraiah.title: Meraiah
meraiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meraiah.note: The priestly family of Seraiah had Meraiah at its head while Joiakim was high priest, and that is all Nehemiah 12:12 says of him.

meraioth.title: Meraioth
meraioth.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
meraioth.note: A priestly name that comes up in the high priest's family line, in Chronicles and in Ezra's own genealogy.

meremoth.title: Meremoth
meremoth.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meremoth.note: The priest who helped weigh the gold and silver vessels Ezra brought back from Babylon. Later he repaired a stretch of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.

meshezabeel-2.title: Meshezabeel
meshezabeel-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshezabeel-2.note: One of 3 men called Meshezabeel. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

meshillemith.title: Meshillemith
meshillemith.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
meshillemith.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

meshullam.title: Meshullam
meshullam.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam.note: Priests, Levites and officials all used this name after the exile. Several of them worked on Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah or in running the temple.

meshullam-15.title: Meshullam
meshullam-15.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-15.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

meshullam-16.title: Meshullam
meshullam-16.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-16.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return. The verse is Nehemiah 12:13.

meshullam-17.title: Meshullam
meshullam-17.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-17.note: One of 20 men called Meshullam. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah. The verse is Nehemiah 12:16.

meshullam-18.title: Meshullam
meshullam-18.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-18.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him. The verse is Nehemiah 12:25.

meshullam-2.title: Meshullam
meshullam-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-2.note: Nehemiah names him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

miamin.title: Miamin
miamin.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
miamin.note: The name of a priestly family listed under Nehemiah, and common among priests after the exile.

mica.title: Mica
mica.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
mica.note: One of 3 men called Mica. This one is a Levite from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

mica-2.title: Mica
mica-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mica-2.note: One of 3 men called Mica. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

micah-4.title: Micah
micah-4.about: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
micah-4.note: The eighth-century prophet of Judah, writing at the same time as Isaiah. His short book attacks the injustice of Israel and Judah and names Bethlehem as the birthplace of a coming ruler, a line Matthew quotes in the nativity. The name means "who is like the LORD."

micha-3.title: Micha
micha-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
micha-3.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

mikmas.title: Mikmas
mikmas.note: Michmash, a town in Benjamin north of Jerusalem. The Philistines gathered there against Saul, and Jonathan and his armour-bearer climbed across a rocky ravine to attack their garrison, which set off a rout. Isaiah pictures the Assyrian army leaving its baggage there, and families from Michmash came back from Babylon.

milalai.title: Milalai
milalai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
milalai.note: At the dedication of Jerusalem's rebuilt walls, Milalai was among the Levite musicians in the procession, probably from Asaph's family.

miniamin.title: Miniamin
miniamin.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
miniamin.note: A priestly name of the years after the exile, carried by men who served in the temple and joined the dedication of the rebuilt walls.

miniamin-2.title: Miniamin
miniamin-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
miniamin-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

moadiah.title: Moadiah
moadiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
moadiah.note: A priestly family head after the exile. Nehemiah spells him Moadiah in one list and Maadiah in another, and nothing more is known.

moladah.title: Moladah
moladah.note: In the Negev. Judah was given it first, then Simeon, whose land sat inside Judah's, and people moved back there after the exile. It is often placed at Tel Malhata, east of Beersheba.

moses.title: Moses
moses.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
moses.note: Born a Hebrew slave in Egypt and raised in Pharaoh's house, he killed an Egyptian overseer and ran to Midian, where he kept sheep for forty years. God called him back from the burning bush to face Pharaoh and lead Israel out. He gave them the law at Sinai, led them forty years in the wilderness, and died at a hundred and twenty within sight of the promised land.

neballat.title: Neballat
neballat.note: Men of Benjamin resettled it after the exile, along with Hadid and Ono. The name lives on in the village of Beit Nabala, a few miles northeast of Lydda.

nehemiah.title: Nehemiah
nehemiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nehemiah.note: Cupbearer to the Persian king Artaxerxes. He used that trust to get leave, money and safe conduct to rebuild Jerusalem's walls, and finished in fifty-two days against constant sabotage. As governor of Judah he forced debt relief for the poor and took on intermarriage and Sabbath breaking.

nethaneel-10.title: Nethaneel
nethaneel-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nethaneel-10.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

nethaneel-9.title: Nethaneel
nethaneel-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nethaneel-9.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

nethinims.title: Nethinims
nethinims.note: Temple servants, probably war captives to begin with, given the heavy work around the Levites. Groups of them come back from Babylon in the return lists.

netophathite.title: Netophathite
netophathite.note: From Netophah, a small town near Bethlehem. Several of David's mighty men carried the name, and later some Levitical singers did too.

nob.title: Nob
nob.note: A town of priests near Jerusalem. David came here running from Saul, and the priest Ahimelech gave him the consecrated bread and Goliath's sword. Saul had the priests of Nob killed for it.

obadiah-3.title: Obadiah
obadiah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
obadiah-3.note: One of 12 men called Obadiah. This one is a Levite from the exile and the return, named twice in 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah.

obadiah-8.title: Obadiah
obadiah-8.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
obadiah-8.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

ono.title: Ono
ono.note: Nehemiah's enemies Sanballat and Tobiah asked him four times to come down and meet them in the plain of Ono, and he would not go. The town belonged to Benjamin, in a fertile plain northwest of Jerusalem, and returning exiles settled it again.

ophel.title: Ophel
ophel.note: Temple servants lived on the Ophel, the fortified stretch of Jerusalem between the temple mount and the city of David, while Nehemiah was rebuilding the wall.

pashur.title: Pashur
pashur.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
pashur.note: His name heads a family that came back from exile, counted in Ezra 2:38 and Nehemiah 7:41. He is not the temple official who had Jeremiah beaten; that man has his own entry.

pedaiah-4.title: Pedaiah
pedaiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pedaiah-4.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

pedaiah-5.title: Pedaiah
pedaiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pedaiah-5.note: One of 7 men called Pedaiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

pelaliah.title: Pelaliah
pelaliah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
pelaliah.note: A name in the line of Adaiah, one of the priests who settled in Jerusalem after the exile. He appears in that list and nowhere else.

perez.title: Perez
perez.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
perez.note: Judah's son by Tamar. He pushed out ahead of his twin Zerah, though Zerah's hand had already been marked with a scarlet thread as the firstborn. His line runs through Boaz to David.

persian.title: Persian
persian.note: Darius the Persian, whose reign is the marker for when the priestly and Levitical family records in Nehemiah 12 were brought up to date.

pethakiah-3.title: Pethakiah
pethakiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pethakiah-3.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

piltai.title: Piltai
piltai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
piltai.note: In the days of the high priest Joiakim, the generation after the return, he headed the priestly family of Moadiah. Nothing further is recorded.

ramah.title: Ramah
ramah.note: Samuel's hometown, and where he was buried. The name was common enough that several towns carried it. Jeremiah's Rachel weeping for her children is set here too.

rehum-2.title: Rehum
rehum-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
rehum-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

sallai.title: Sallai
sallai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sallai.note: A common name after the exile, and this one turns up in Nehemiah's lists of the families who came back.

sanballat.title: Sanballat
sanballat.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sanballat.note: The main enemy Nehemiah faced while the walls of Jerusalem went back up. A Samaritan official, Sanballat mocked the work, plotted attacks, and tried to lure Nehemiah into a trap.

seraiah.title: Seraiah
seraiah.about: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
seraiah.note: The chief priest in Jerusalem when it fell. Nebuchadnezzar had him executed, and the name runs on through several later generations of priests.

seraiah-2.title: Seraiah
seraiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
seraiah-2.note: A Seraiah from the years of the return, not the chief priest Nebuchadnezzar executed. The name sits in Ezra 2:2 and again in the Nehemiah lists.

shabbethai-2.title: Shabbethai
shabbethai-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shabbethai-2.note: One of 3 men called Shabbethai. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

shalthiel.title: Shalthiel
shalthiel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shalthiel.note: Zerubbabel's father. He came from the exiled king Jehoiachin, so through him David's royal line can be traced through the Babylonian captivity.

shammua.title: Shammua
shammua.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
shammua.note: One of David's sons, named in 2 Samuel 5:14 and 1 Chronicles 14:4. Nehemiah 11:17 has the name again for a later man.

shammua-2.title: Shammua
shammua-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shammua-2.note: One of 3 men called Shammua. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

shebaniah-2.title: Shebaniah
shebaniah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shebaniah-2.note: Nehemiah names him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

shecaniah.title: Shecaniah
shecaniah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shecaniah.note: A name in the royal line after the exile, at 1 Chronicles 3:21 and 3:22. Nehemiah 12:3 has a priest who carried it.

shelemiah-7.title: Shelemiah
shelemiah-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shelemiah-7.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

shemaiah-6.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-6.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-6.note: A levite from the exile and the return. 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice.

shemaiah-2.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-2.note: Named in Nehemiah 10:8 among those who sealed the covenant, and again in the priestly lists of Nehemiah 12.

shemaiah-22.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-22.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-22.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

shemaiah-23.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-23.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-23.note: One of 26 men called Shemaiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

shemaiah-24.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-24.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-24.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him. The verse is Nehemiah 12:42.

shephatiah-9.title: Shephatiah
shephatiah-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shephatiah-9.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

sherebiah-2.title: Sherebiah
sherebiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sherebiah-2.note: A Levite in the Nehemiah lists. He sealed the covenant in Nehemiah 10:12 and appears again among the Levites of Nehemiah 12.

shilonite.title: Shilonite
shilonite.note: A man from Shiloh. It is what they called the prophet Ahijah, who tore his cloak into twelve pieces to show that God would split Solomon's kingdom.

solomon.title: Solomon
solomon.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
solomon.note: David and Bathsheba's son, and Israel's third king. He was rushed onto the throne after his half-brother Adonijah tried to take it while David lay dying. Early on he asked God for wisdom.

talmon.title: Talmon
talmon.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
talmon.note: He headed a family of temple gatekeepers, and his descendants were still keeping the gates after the exile.

tobiah.title: Tobiah
tobiah.about: Nehemiah's adversary living at the time of Exile and Return
tobiah.note: They called him the Ammonite. With Sanballat he mocked Nehemiah's wall and worked against it, and later a priest gave him a room inside the temple courts, so Nehemiah threw him and his things out.

unni-2.title: Unni
unni-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
unni-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

uzzi-5.title: Uzzi
uzzi-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uzzi-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

uzzi-6.title: Uzzi
uzzi-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uzzi-6.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

uzzi-7.title: Uzzi
uzzi-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uzzi-7.note: One of 7 men called Uzzi. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

uzziah-5.title: Uzziah
uzziah-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uzziah-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

zabdi.title: Zabdi
zabdi.note: Achan's grandfather. When Joshua went looking for who had taken the plunder from Jericho, the lot came down through his household.

zabdiel-2.title: Zabdiel
zabdiel-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zabdiel-2.note: Overseer of the able men doing temple work in Jerusalem after the exile.

zaccur.title: Zaccur
zaccur.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zaccur.note: A Levite musician in 1 Chronicles 25, drawn by lot for his turn of service.

zaccur-6.title: Zaccur
zaccur-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zaccur-6.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

zachariah-22.title: Zachariah
zachariah-22.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-22.note: A levite from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

zachariah-23.title: Zachariah
zachariah-23.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-23.note: One of 29 men called Zachariah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah. The verse is Nehemiah 11:4.

zachariah-24.title: Zachariah
zachariah-24.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-24.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him. The verse is Nehemiah 11:5.

zachariah-25.title: Zachariah
zachariah-25.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-25.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return. The verse is Nehemiah 12:16.

zachariah-26.title: Zachariah
zachariah-26.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-26.note: One of 29 men called Zachariah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah. The verse is Nehemiah 12:35.

zachariah-27.title: Zachariah
zachariah-27.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-27.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him. The verse is Nehemiah 12:41.

zadok-5.title: Zadok
zadok-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zadok-5.note: One of 7 men called Zadok. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

zadok-2.title: Zadok
zadok-2.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zadok-2.note: A later Zadok in the priestly line, in the genealogies of Chronicles, Ezra and Nehemiah.

zanoah.title: Zanoah
zanoah.note: A town in Judah. Its people repaired one of Jerusalem's gates when Nehemiah rebuilt the walls.

zarah.title: Zarah
zarah.about: Judah's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zarah.note: Judah's son by Tamar, Perez's twin. His hand came out first and the midwife tied a scarlet thread on it, and then Perez was born ahead of him.

zareah.title: Zareah
zareah.note: Samson's hometown, better known as Zorah, on the border of Judah and Dan. The angel of the Lord told Manoah's wife there that she would have a son, and Samson was buried between Zorah and Eshtaol.

zeboim.title: Zeboim
zeboim.note: Benjamites resettled this village after the exile, and it is not the Zeboim destroyed with Sodom and Gomorrah.

zerubbabel.title: Zerubbabel
zerubbabel.about: Governor living at the time of Exile and Return
zerubbabel.note: He came from David's line and led the first exiles back from Babylon to Jerusalem. As governor he laid the temple's foundation and, with Haggai and Zechariah pushing, saw it finished.

zichri-11.title: Zichri
zichri-11.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zichri-11.note: One of 12 men called Zichri. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

zichri-12.title: Zichri
zichri-12.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zichri-12.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.
